author: _Azazzel
body:
1. I've never been a staff member 
2. I'm not really good at pvp which makes me think people are hacking SOMETIMES
3. I can improve staff Team by not giving out personal questions and answers and also making ideas of how to improve the staff team
4. A leader must be very respectful and help other people out which I would do if I was a leader
5. I respect other people with love and kindness
6. I think I need Moderation skills
7. I would want to become a staff member as long as I have fun on avic
8. I would temp-ban or kick the player and tell the mods from the staff team and tell them that a player is hacking and I can't do anything because I'm a Jr Mod
9.I would Tell the leader to kick that player out because he isn't doing his job and just harassing people.
10. I would tell the players online that were there that if player broke the rules an accident and if it was true that the player was innocent than I unban the player and tell them that what he actually did.
11. I would just ignore those, if its something bad than I'll tell them to stop or just ignore them.
12. If I disagree and every one doesn't, then I'll go with it.
13. It means a lot because I've been wanting to become a moderate sense the day I stopped disrespecting other players and became more kind
14. Avic is the only server I play because it has destroy which is a really cool game on avic
15. I speak Spanish, English, and some french



Age: 13
Time Zone: Pacific time
 I don't have access in team speak
I don't have access in Skype. 
I'll get microphone soon.
